verdicts.reason: Both use the same broken layout. The white cloud shape and its sparkles float as an empty white-on-white blob that means nothing without the photo behind it. The headline 'JOIN OUR CHOIR!' is tiny and smaller than the tracked-out subline 'EVERYONE IS WELCOME!', so the hierarchy is inverted. The photo has shrunk to a small thumbnail and the elements are spread across the banner as unrelated fragments with no layering. A's photo is slightly bigger but sits closer to the left edge; B has more even margins but an even smaller image. Neither is better.
